## What Yousef builds

Yousef Mohammed Salah builds practical software at the intersection of artificial intelligence,
cybersecurity, full-stack web engineering, and competitive programming. His public portfolio
contains original project case studies, technical writing, certificates, and hackathon results.

## Featured projects

- [Verdict.run](https://www.yust.dev/projects/verdict-run) — competitive programming platform with a built-in IDE, whiteboard, custom judge, mirror mode, and algorithm visualisation. Live site: https://verdict.run
- [Sast.tech](https://www.yust.dev/projects/sast-tech) — autonomous AI security agent that finds web vulnerabilities, patches code, and generates verified reports. Live site: https://sast.tech
- [SpaceWorth](https://www.yust.dev/projects/spaceworth) — machine-learning real-estate valuation engine with CAD floor-plan OCR.
- [ICPC HUE](https://www.yust.dev/projects/icpc-hue) — online-judge and training ecosystem led for the Horus University competitive-programming community.
- [Zero Threat](https://www.yust.dev/projects/zero-threat) — AI-powered cybersecurity suite spanning a web platform, browser extension, and Windows agent.
- [SWRMZ](https://www.yust.dev/projects/swrmz) — cooperative swarm of AI security agents for vulnerability remediation and runtime monitoring.
- [MonTerminal](https://www.yust.dev/projects/monterminal) — Monad on-chain trading and automation terminal.
- [Hellish Golf](https://www.yust.dev/projects/hellishgolf) — daily golf challenge built for Reddit's Games with a Hook hackathon.
